en.headline: Woman wounded in Yuen Long street attack, suspect still at large
en.dek: Police classified the Friday night incident on Fung Nin Road as wounding and are seeking a man aged about 20 to 30.
body: A 31-year-old woman was wounded on Friday night after a man attacked her with a cutter on Fung Nin Road in Yuen Long, police said, and the suspect remains at large.

The woman reported the attack at about 9.14pm near No. 20 Fung Nin Road, outside Yuen Long Merchants Association Secondary School. She was conscious when ambulance crews arrived, treated at the scene and taken first to Pok Oi Hospital, then to Tuen Mun Hospital.

Police classified the case as wounding and are seeking a man aged about 20 to 30. Local reports said officers later searched nearby school grounds with torches and diverted pedestrians while looking for the attacker, who was believed to have fled towards Yuen Long Plaza.
Police sources cited by local media said the incident may have involved a money dispute. Anyone with information is asked to contact police.

zh.headline: 元朗豐年路女子遇襲受傷 疑犯在逃
zh.dek: 警方將周五晚案件列作傷人，正追緙一名約20至30歲男子。
body: 一名31歲女子周五晚上在元朗豐年路懷疑被男子以鎝刀襲擊受傷，警方表示疑犯仍然在逃。
女子約晚上9時14分報案，指在豐年路20號元朗商會中學對開遇襲。救護員到場時她仍然清醒，現場包絞後先送博愛醫院，其後轉送屯門醫院治理。
警方將案件列作傷人，正追緙一名約20至30歲男子。有報道指大批軍裝警員其後到附近校園範圍以電筒搜索，並呼籲途人改道，懷疑對方循元朗廣場方向逃走。
本地傳媒引述消息指，事件可能涉及金錢糾紛。警方呼籲市民提供資料。
